name: Orlistat
description: Gut lipase inhibitor that blocks the digestion of dietary fat; acts in the stomach and small intestine

note.text: Xenical 120 mg is prescription-only; Alli 60 mg is sold over the counter to overweight adults.

bullets: **Binds and switches off** lipases in the stomach and small intestine (label)
**Undigested fat** is not absorbed and passes out in the stool
**Fewer calories** are taken in as a result
**Acts in the gut;** systemic exposure is minimal
Many people did not finish the trials

notEstablished.text: PK in kidney or liver disease

practical.halfLife: 1 to 2 hours for absorbed orlistat (limited data, label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Minimal absorption; about 97% of a dose leaves in feces
practical.monitored: Weight; HIV viral load if on HIV drugs (label)

references: Torgerson et al., XENDOS, Diabetes Care, Jan 2004
